name: replay-theater
description: Replay local Codex native file edits, view saved records and export an offline replay using a self-contained skill.

interface.longDescription: Replay recorded native file edits from local Codex history in a browser viewer with a film timeline, playback, file filtering and split or unified diffs. Open a supplied saved Replay Theater JSON record or export a self-contained offline HTML replay. Free to use. Live history collection requires Python 3.9 or later, a compatible local Codex app-server and permission to access that history. Saved-record viewing and export require Python and accessible input files. The bundled viewer currently uses Simplified Chinese labels. This edition includes skills and local resources only; it has no MCP connection or automatic file-capture hooks and does not collect Shell, formatter or MCP changes. It can display existing v1/v2 snapshots supplied by the user. It does not reconstruct missing full-file versions.
defaultPrompt: Replay the recorded file edits from my previous Codex turn.
Open this saved Replay Theater JSON record.
Export this saved replay as an offline HTML file.

publication.release_notes: Skills-only local replay edition. Includes native history collection, saved-record viewing and offline HTML export. No MCP configuration, lifecycle hooks or automatic capture. The full local plugin remains separately available.
